story.head: The Sabres are searching for answers
paras: The Capitals won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-3 in overtime in Washington on Oct 24. The Capitals are on a three-game losing streak, and the Sabres are winless in five (0-4-1). Going in, the Sabres are sixth in the Atlantic (tied for 22nd in the NHL) and the Caps fifth in the Metropolitan (tied for 22nd).

The Sabres have played better than their record (.476) says: their chances are worth about .529, and their finishing has held them back. The Capitals’ record (.526) is about what their chances are worth.
In their five-game skid, the Sabres have been outscored 21-9, including 14-7 at 5-on-5.

The Sabres rarely get pinned in their own end (4th) and get their defensemen shooting (5th), but don’t block many shots (30th). On the other side, the Capitals get their shots through better than almost anyone (3rd) and play fast, open games (5th). They also get the league’s best looks (1st), so the Capitals could find some good looks against the Sabres, who give up plenty of them. Washington has allowed 3.68 goals a game, the fourth most in the league. The Sabres could find some good looks against the Capitals, who give up plenty of them.

Tage Thompson (13 G / 10 A / 23 P in 21 GP) leads the Sabres in scoring, and Jack Quinn (9 G / 10 A / 19 P in 21 GP) isn’t far behind. For the Capitals, Dylan Strome (3 G / 13 A / 16 P in 19 GP) leads the way in scoring, with seven goals in ten games against Buffalo since 2023-24. Alex Tuch (12 G / 2 A / 14 P in 19 GP) has a team-high twelve goals, tied for tenth in the NHL.

Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen (5-4-3 / .867 SV% in 11 GS) has had a rough start to the season for Buffalo, but is expected to start. Logan Thompson (7-6-0 / .885 SV% in 14 GS) is expected to go for Washington. Thompson has a .846 save percentage in five starts against the Sabres, well under his usual .911. Don’t read much into it: a goalie’s record against one team rarely holds up.
At home, Spencer Carbery likes to send Protas, Dubois and Tuch out against the other team’s top line, so watch for them against Benson, Kulich and Thompson.
